title: The Telangana Industrial Workers (Representation, Participation in Management and Relief) Act, 1998.
full_text: The Telangana Industrial Workers (Representation, Participation in Management and Relief) Act, 1998. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 199824 Act Number: 24 Enactment Date: 1998-06-20 Act Year: 1998 Short Title: The Telangana Industrial Workers (Representation, Participation in Management and Relief) Act, 1998. Long Title: An Act to provide for recognition to trade unions with a view to facilitating collective bargaining and provide for participation of workers in management of industrial establishments, protection of works, constitution of contingency fund to provide relief to the workmen affected by closure of industrial establishments due to sickness or otherwise and for matters connected therewith and incidental thereto.
